input.overview: Choose a character at the grinder scoop, then repeat the lane tied to that story three times to start its next mode. Finish both modes on a lane to light the connected mini-wizard, while keeping Door and Hook Multiballs ready for safer progress.
input.simpleOverview: Choose a character at the grinder scoop and hit the matching major shot three times. Grandpa and Gas Station start at the left ramp; Hitchhiker and Cook qualify at the left orbit and start through the door.
input.summary: Choose a character at the grinder scoop, then make the matching lane shot three times for its next mode. Finish both modes in a lane to light its mini-wizard. Build Door at the center and Hook Multiball with captive-ball hits and right-orbit locks.
checkBeforePlay: Mode-qualification counts can be reduced in the operator menu. Trust the lit progress and door callouts if the machine does not require the default tutorial count.
Confirm v1.00 or newer if you expect Franklin progression, Super Shot, The Family, and Bonus Ball behavior described here.

quickInfo.name: Start Grandpa or Gas Station
quickInfo.summary: Choose the matching character and shoot the left ramp three times for the next mode in that lane.

quickInfo.name: Start Hitchhiker or Cook
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the left orbit three times, then hit the captive ball to open the moving door and shoot through it.

quickInfo.name: Door Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center door shot three times, then knock the held ball off its magnet to begin.

quickInfo.name: Hook Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the captive ball twice to light a Hook lock, collect at the right orbit, and repeat through the third start.

steps.text: At the grinder scoop, choose the character tied to the story lane you want to advance.
For Grandpa and then Gas Station, shoot the left ramp three times. Each third shot starts the next mode in that lane.
For Hitchhiker and then Cook, shoot the left orbit three times, hit the captive ball to open the moving door, and shoot through the door to start.
Finish the second phase of both modes in a lane to light its connected mini-wizard, then take the lit center start shot.
For Door Multiball, shoot the center door three times, then hit the ball held on the magnet to begin. For Hook Multiball, hit the captive ball twice, collect the right-orbit lock, and repeat.
Build combos for the Super Shot. Double-tap the extra-flipper button to apply the multiplier to the next shot; completing combos and using Super Shot also works toward the v1.00 Bonus Ball.
Advance Grandpa and Gas Station, then play their connected mini-wizard.
Advance Hitchhiker and Cook, then play their connected mini-wizard.
Advance Leatherface and The Family, then start Dinner when it lights.
Keep the additional Franklin progression moving at the inner loop on current code.

playfieldReferences.label: Character-select scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The scoop beneath the grinder used to choose the active character.

playfieldReferences.label: Center door
playfieldReferences.description: The captive-ball-controlled door used for mode starts and Door Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Hook lock orbit
playfieldReferences.description: The right orbit that sends a qualified ball onto the physical Hook lock.

cautions.response: Use the three-shot default only as a baseline and follow the machine's lit progress when settings differ.
